Name: (CP) Dacar Wedding Reception anime style portraits (RSV-Others)
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
[color=#00ff00][b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Jn6N88vK/Instalation-Guide.png[/img][/b][/color]
To install this mod you need to unpack the files in the zip on the "Mods" folder or wherever you have RSV installed. This mod contains my mod and a copy of one json from RSV, it will ask you to replace a file named "Tilesheets.json", just acept and it should work!
This copy only changes one line of code so it doesn't break anything, just allows me to use scale up for this mod.

[b][color=#ff0000][img]https://i.postimg.cc/pTXf3rGp/Caution.png[/img][/color][/b]
Due to this mod having to replace a file in RSV whenever you need to update it or install it again you'll need to replace the file with the one from this mod. There will be a optional file with just the RSV file so it won't be necessary to install the mod again.

This mod uses Scale Up 2.

The mod currently includes Wedding Reception portraits for:
- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19796]Vanilla[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31019]Vanilla Seasonals[/url] [/b](includes 2 changes for characters like Sam and Emily for when their hair changes +  Seasonals toggles)
- [b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23522]Ridgeside Village[/url]
[/b]- [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31375]Professor Jasper[/url][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32228]Rasmodia[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32227]Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19956/]SVE[/url]/ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32740] Seasonal SVE[/url]

More portraits will be added as I go on!
I would also be down to do personalized reception portraits, if people would like to commision some.
